provenance.source_kind: review claim communicated before any WP2A Step-2 execution
provenance.source_locator: external review exchange without an immutable third-party locator or signature; exact value imported here to make the previously non-durable claim checkable inside the registered Git history
provenance.relationship_to_v1_2: The first eight and last seven hex characters equal the 60 bits recorded by v1.2; v1.3 durably registers the complete 256-bit value supplied by the same prior observation.
provenance.evidential_weight: The pre-registration chronology becomes independently auditable only after this file is published. A Step-2 match is a reproduction of the imported claim, not proof of its earlier external timestamp and not provider attestation.

anti_circularity_rule: The expected SHA-256 and size are read only from this committed artifact before any provider input is opened. No observed Step-2 value may populate or amend an expected field. A mismatch is `contradicts`; extractor disagreement is `evidence_assurance_failed`.
